# Watermouse — Google Ads for European eCommerce

> Watermouse is senior, EU-experienced Google Ads management for European eCommerce brands — one senior operator directly on your account, no junior handoffs, no bloated retainer. Pricing is a flat monthly fee (€1,500–€4,000/mo), not a percentage of ad spend. Markets include the Netherlands, the UK, and Germany/DACH. Run by Rodrigo Kato, a senior Google Ads consultant.

## Core pages
- [Home — Google Ads for European eCommerce](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/): Senior Google Ads management for EU eCommerce brands, without the agency bloat.
- [Pricing](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-pricing.html): Transparent flat-rate plans — Starter €1,500/mo, Growth €2,500/mo, Scale €4,000/mo. Flat fee, not % of spend; no long lock-in.
- [About — Rodrigo Kato](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-about.html): Senior Google Ads consultant; one operator directly on the account, no handoffs; founded in Brazil, built for Europe.
- [Case studies](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-case-studies.html): Real results for European eCommerce brands — TicketSwap, Artipoppe, LandLife.
- [Book a free audit](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-book-a-call.html): A free 30-minute audit of your Google Ads account — honest feedback, no pitch until you ask.

## Services
- [Performance Max for eCommerce](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-pmax-ecommerce.html): PMax management done properly — feed, audience signals, brand exclusions, and honest reporting so it scales profit instead of hiding waste.
- [Google Shopping & feed management](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-google-shopping-feed.html): Product feed optimisation, Merchant Center health, and custom-label segmentation to lift Shopping performance at the source.

## Markets
- [Google Ads — Netherlands](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-google-ads-netherlands.html): Google Ads for Dutch eCommerce — iDEAL checkout, bilingual search intent, Sinterklaas seasonality.
- [Google Ads — United Kingdom](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-google-ads-uk.html): Google Ads for the high-CPC, Shopping-led UK eCommerce market.
- [Google Ads — Germany & DACH](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-google-ads-germany.html): Google Ads for German-speaking markets — native-German creative, price-comparison culture, consent-compliant measurement.

## Guides
- [How much does Google Ads management cost for eCommerce?](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-guide-google-ads-cost.html): The three pricing models (% of spend, flat fee, in-house), what drives the price, and how to sanity-check any quote. Key point: a good management fee should fall as a share of spend as you grow.
- [Google Ads agency vs freelancer vs in-house](https://agency.thewatermouse.com/watermouse-guide-agency-vs-freelancer.html): The real question is who does the daily work and how senior they are. How to choose by your stage and spend, with the questions to ask before you hire.
